question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate phrasal verb:
The fire was so intense that the firefighters struggled to ___ it ___.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **put — out**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb **"put out"** means to extinguish something, typically a fire or light. (बुझाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighters worked hard to put out the flames before they spread further.
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the firefighters struggled to extinguish the fire, which is why the correct phrasal verb here is **"put — out"**. (बुझाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The fire was so intense that the firefighters struggled to put it out.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **put — out**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: put — off** (टालना): To delay or postpone something.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to put off their vacation due to the bad weather.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: set — in** (शुरू होना): To begin or become established, especially something unpleasant like an illness or bad weather.
 
 
• **Example:** After the rain set in, we had to cancel our plans for outdoor activities.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: take — over** (संभालना): To assume control or responsibility for something.
 
 
• **Example:** The new manager will take over the operations from next month.
